addins.title: NVIDIA GPU support
addins.description: Installs the NVIDIA driver (nvidia-smi, monitoring, overclocking) and the NVIDIA Container Toolkit so Docker apps can use the GPU. Downloaded from Debian and NVIDIA once, kept on your array, and re-installed automatically at every boot.

sources.name: nonfree
sources.line: deb http://deb.debian.org/debian bookworm main contrib non-free non-free-firmware

apt.packages_note: libcuda1, libnvcuvid1, libnvidia-encode1: CUDA, NVDEC and NVENC for transcoding (Plex, Jellyfin); nvidia-driver does not pull them in with --no-install-recommends (CLAUDE.md §53)

addins.title: AMD graphics for virtual machines
addins.description: Lets VMs use this machine's AMD graphics (including Ryzen integrated graphics) for 3D through a virtual GPU (virtio-gpu with virgl), while the picture still shows in the browser console. Installs AMD's graphics firmware and QEMU's 3D module, then starts the AMD driver. Kept on your array and re-installed automatically at every boot. In the VM's XML, add <acceleration accel3d='yes'/> to the virtio video model and an egl-headless graphics device using the render node.

apt.packages_note: qemu-system-gui carries hw-display-virtio-gpu-gl.so and pulls in libvirglrenderer1 (bookworm has no separate opengl module package)
